leadText: Volume 7 is the seventh volume of the Pokémon RéBURST manga written by Jin Kusude and illustrated by Mitsuhisa Tamura.
plainText:
Volume 7 is the seventh volume of the Pokémon RéBURST manga written by Jin Kusude and illustrated by Mitsuhisa Tamura.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 01 (58): The Three Assassins
Chapter 02 (59): The Three Generals
Chapter 03 (60): Ryouga and Amu
Chapter 04 (61): The Saviors Appear!
Chapter 05 (62): What happened to Hariru!?
Chapter 06 (63): Hariru's Evolution
Chapter 07 (64): Metal
Chapter 08 (65): Respective Barriers
Chapter 09 (66): Betrayal and Revenge and ...
Chapter 10 (67): Evolution Against the Strongest

==Important events==
 
Kigyan, Lukov, and Toga attempts to take over Great Gavel, but are eventually defeated by the Three Generals Amu, Rovy, and Ganku.
Ryouga, Karuta, and Rug fights the Three Generals, but the Karuta and Rug were easily defeated by Rovy and Ganku.
Hariru and Carola reappear and battle Rovy and Ganku.
Hariru's evolves into along with his Burst form and defeats both Rovy and Ganku.
Ryouga also defeats Amu.
Hariru battles Fraud again.
